input.summary: Add Customer affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, reasonableness standard and competitor bar on Vendor assignment, and confirm no change-of-control termination or re-pricing.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a blanket bar on assignment: we need to be able to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without Garman's consent, and Garman should not be able to assign to one of our competitors or treat our change of control as a termination or re-pricing event. We have also aligned Section 3(c) so it does not cut across this carve-out; a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Sparkling may assign this Agreement and its rights and obligations under this Agreement, without the consent of Garman, to an affiliate of Sparkling or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates. Garman may not assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Sparkling (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of Sparkling. A change of control of Sparkling shall not constitute an assignment of this Agreement and shall not give Garman any right to terminate, suspend, re-price or otherwise vary this Agreement.

ops.oldText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: (c) except as permitted by Section 20(d), not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
